name: zvideo_dd_image_upload_pixels_to_surface
description: zVideo_dd::Image_UploadPixelsToSurface skips the 3dfx renderer path, lazily creates a DirectDraw surface when needed, then acquires a GDI DC from the image surface.
known_limits: Local VC5SP3 COFF byte comparison target zvideo_dd_image_upload_pixels_to_surface now covers 0x4a8680 but remains blocked at 69 unmasked mismatches after 20 relocation-masked bytes and 9 trimmed VC NOP bytes. Remaining tier S drift is return-block layout around renderer/lazy-create zero returns and GetDC success/error epilogue ordering.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4a8680 validates fastcall ECX=image and EDX=outHdc, early return when g_zVideo_RendererType is 2, existing image->surface bypassing lazy creation, lazy Image_LazyCreateBackingSurface when image->surface is null, selected-device feature flag read for cap selection, DDSCAPS_NONLOCALVIDMEM | DDSCAPS_VIDEOMEMORY when feature flags are nonzero, DDSCAPS_SYSTEMMEMORY otherwise, failed lazy creation returning 0 before GetDC, provider IDirectDrawSurface3::GetDC through vtable offset 0x44, return 1 on DD_OK, and ReportError with zvid_dd.c line 0x36d plus return 0 on GetDC failure.

Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x4a8680 has no warnings in the current database and matches the corrected source implementation. The prior limited reconstruction marker is stale for this session's evidence.

The dependency frontier shows no remaining authored source blockers; zVideo_dd::Image_LazyCreateBackingSurface and zVideo_dd::ReportError are tier C or better, and GetDC is a DirectDraw provider call.

The native smoke verifies the renderer-type skip, existing-surface GetDC success and failure paths, lazy system-memory surface creation and GetDC, feature-driven nonlocal video-memory surface creation and GetDC, failed lazy creation returning before GetDC, descriptor cap propagation through the shared backing-surface creator, and copied/rebound pixel data.
